QuestInfo.name: Bringing a Mirror to Heena
QuestInfo.1: I got the mirror from #b#p2##k, who was doing her laundry. I have to take it to #b#p1##k now.
QuestInfo.2: I got the mirror from #b#p2##k, who was doing her laundry, and took it to #b#p1##k.

0.0: How am I going to hang all these up? What a hassle. What? You want my mirror? Please don't tell me #b#p1##k asked you for this...
0.1: Seriously, she should have come to get it herself. She is sooo lazy. Fine, fine, here's the mirror.

no.0: Oh? Why aren't you accepting the mirror? Do you no longer wish to see #b#p1##k?

1.0: Oh wow! You brought #b#p2##k's mirror! Thank you so, so much. Let's see... No skin damage whatsoever... Whew! That's a relief.

yes.0: If you go right, you will see a shiny aura. We call that a portal. If you press #bup arrow#k, you will teleport to the next area. So long!

npc.0: It looks like you haven't delivered the mirror to #b#p1##k yet. Please hurry!

item.0: Did you lose the mirror? Ask my sister for it again, then.
